description.value: Unchai Thai Restaurant is a fast-casual Thai kitchen on Burrard Street in Vancouver, serving noodle soups, curries with rice, stir-fried noodles, and desserts made with homemade pastes, coconut milk, and fresh herbs like kaffir lime leaf and Thai basil. The restaurant has received coverage from The Globe and Mail, the Vancouver Sun, and other local food media for its comforting, flavour-forward approach to Thai classics. Cyclists can dine in at the Burrard Street location or call ahead to arrange takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (name, address, phone, website). No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. One internal contradiction noted: hours list Monday times in one place but say 'Closed on Mondays' elsewhere, flagged in concerns.
